csv_scope_of_work: Texas Woman s University ( Owner ) is soliciting statements of qualifications ( Qualifications ) for selection of an Architect/Engineer firm for Project No. 100136. project is a significantly enlarged, state-of-the-art weight room designed to accommodate the specialized strength and conditioning needs of multiple teams simultaneously. The successful addition of new programs like STUNT, Wrestling, Artistic Swimming, and our nationally recognized dance team has elevated the university's prestige but has also pushed our current facilities to full capacity. To keep the momentum going, TWU aims to invest in an athletic complex that reflects its status as a leading institution for competitive sports. Although the expansion of these programs is the main driver behind this proposal, the new facility is intended to benefit all Pioneer teams. Our key sports-basketball, volleyball, and gymnastics need modernized training equipment to stay competitive in the NCAA, while soccer and softball require dedicated support spaces that current layouts cannot accommodate. Central to this project is a significantly enlarged, state-of-the-art weight room designed to accommodate the specialized strength and conditioning needs of multiple teams simultaneously. By adding a much-needed locker rooms with dedicated team spaces, we ensure that every athlete, regardless of their sport, has a home that fosters the Pioneer identity and excellence.
